description: This file defines API routes related to session management within a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting sessions, and posting messages to sessions. It interacts with a Supabase backend for data persistence and applies dependency injection for user authentication.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Data model representing a user session.

classes.name: SessionsList
classes.description: Container for a list of Session objects.

classes.name: MessageCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new message.

classes.name: MessageItem
classes.description: Data model representing a message item.

classes.name: SessionWithMessages
classes.description: Extended session model including associated messages.

methods.name: list_sessions(user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all sessions for the current user.

methods.name: create_session(payload: SessionCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session for the current user.

methods.name: get_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by ID, including its messages.

methods.name: update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Updates metadata of an existing session.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
post_message(session_id: str, payload: MessageCreate, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Posts a new message to a session, validates ownership, and generates an assistant placeholder reply.
